spec.goal: Build the two-day program of the conference from the talk submissions and the speakers' emails. Place every talk on the rooms x slots grid of one day, in its own track, with no room or speaker double-booked, every speaker available at their slot, every room big enough for its expected audience, and never two talks of one track at the same time. Honor the speakers' time preferences where possible, and write a short blurb per session.

root_goal.goal: Build the two-day program of the conference from the talk submissions and the speakers' emails. Place every talk on the rooms x slots grid of one day, in its own track, with no room or speaker double-booked, every speaker available at their slot, every room big enough for its expected audience, and never two talks of one track at the same time. Honor the speakers' time preferences where possible, and write a short blurb per session.

abstracts.abstract: Why accessible interfaces is harder than it looks, and a design that holds up. No prior experience is needed, but familiarity with the basics helps. We expect around 31 attendees.

abstracts.abstract: We share the mistakes we made with cost-aware warehousing and how we fixed them. The session ends with a checklist attendees can apply on Monday. Last year a similar session drew roughly 60 people.
abstracts.speaker: Kemi Byrne
abstracts.title: Cost-aware warehousing: what actually worked

abstracts.abstract: Why data contracts is harder than it looks, and a design that holds up. The session ends with a checklist attendees can apply on Monday. Last year a similar session drew roughly 50 people.
abstracts.speaker: Rosa Iyer
abstracts.title: Lessons from data contracts in production

abstracts.abstract: This talk walks through how our team approached stream processing over the past year. No prior experience is needed, but familiarity with the basics helps. Last year a similar session drew roughly 66 people.

abstracts.title: Stream processing without the hype

abstracts.abstract: Why SQLite at the edge is harder than it looks, and a design that holds up. Expect concrete numbers, a few failure stories and an open-source companion repo. Last year a similar session drew roughly 83 people.

abstracts.title: Rethinking SQLite at the edge

abstracts.title: Scaling change data capture for small teams

abstracts.title: Scaling schema evolution for small teams

abstracts.abstract: This talk walks through how our team approached data lineage over the past year. No prior experience is needed, but familiarity with the basics helps. Organizers of past editions told us to plan for around 146 people.
abstracts.speaker: Elif Fischer
abstracts.title: Scaling data lineage for small teams

abstracts.abstract: We share the mistakes we made with lakehouse tables and how we fixed them. No prior experience is needed, but familiarity with the basics helps. Organizers of past editions told us to plan for around 36 people.
abstracts.speaker: Olga Sato
abstracts.title: A practical guide to lakehouse tables

abstracts.abstract: A hands-on look at query optimization, with code and real measurements. We compare three approaches and explain the trade-offs we accepted. Last year a similar session drew roughly 39 people.
abstracts.speaker: Pablo Haddad
abstracts.title: A practical guide to query optimization

abstracts.abstract: This talk walks through how our team approached columnar storage over the past year. We compare three approaches and explain the trade-offs we accepted. Expected audience: about 73 participants.
abstracts.speaker: Yusuf Kowalski
abstracts.title: A practical guide to columnar storage

abstracts.abstract: Why vector databases is harder than it looks, and a design that holds up. Expect concrete numbers, a few failure stories and an open-source companion repo. Organizers of past editions told us to plan for around 54 people.
abstracts.speaker: Carmen Novak
abstracts.title: Vector databases: what actually worked

abstracts.abstract: A hands-on look at event sourcing, with code and real measurements. No prior experience is needed, but familiarity with the basics helps. Last year a similar session drew roughly 31 people.
abstracts.speaker: Bruno Sato
abstracts.title: A practical guide to event sourcing

abstracts.abstract: A hands-on look at lakehouse tables, with code and real measurements. No prior experience is needed, but familiarity with the basics helps. We expect around 44 attendees.
abstracts.speaker: Hiro Sato
abstracts.title: Lakehouse tables without the hype

abstracts.abstract: We share the mistakes we made with cost-aware warehousing and how we fixed them. The session ends with a checklist attendees can apply on Monday. Last year a similar session drew roughly 90 people.
abstracts.speaker: Olga Sato
abstracts.title: A practical guide to cost-aware warehousing
